process.title: From idea to film
process.intro: Five stages. The frames show the film gaining colour as it takes shape.

steps.name: Idea
steps.text: You bring the idea, the audience and the deadline.

steps.name: Story
steps.text: We write the script and shape the story scene by scene.

steps.name: Look
steps.text: Characters, world and style frames, approved before production.

steps.name: Production
steps.text: Every shot is generated, directed and refined until it holds up.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Edit, sound, music and colour grade, delivered in every format you need.

about.title: About BubaPix
about.p1: BubaPix is an independent studio where filmmaking craft meets generative tools. We treat AI as a camera, not a shortcut: every film still needs a story worth telling, a deliberate look, and someone who cares about each frame.
about.p2: We make films for brands, musicians and independent storytellers, from a single scene to a complete film.
